verdict.rationale: SumUp's API/SDK/MCP docs cover checkouts, terminal payments, refunds, webhooks, and account management, giving broad functional parity with core payment operations described in the docs (sumup-docs-1,3,6,16,25). However, several UI-only merchant features (e.g., customer rewards, automated marketing promotions) appear nowhere in the API docs, and a probe found no discoverable OpenAPI spec, suggesting gaps in documented completeness. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that all dashboard/merchant-management features (marketing, promotions, reporting) are exposed via API, and a public OpenAPI/swagger spec proving full endpoint parity.
